## Outcome

What customer problem or engineering gap does this change address?

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant tests/build pass.
- [ ] Claims distinguish tested, partial, inspected, blocked and planned work.
- [ ] Publication scanner passes for staged changes.
- [ ] Any `site/` content is safe for unauthenticated public viewing.
- [ ] No credentials, internal source documents or authentic personal/customer data are included.
- [ ] No model budget, capacity, paid service, protected resource or network policy was changed without explicit approval.

## Evidence and limitations

Record the tested scope, known gaps, upstream provenance and cost/operational implications.
